Match cell metadata to RNA cells and flag eligible S-phase cells

Source: R/progression_markers.R
prepare_metadata.Rd

Aligns the merged cell metadata with the RNA cell IDs (prefixing metadata row names with "<sample>-" when that matches more cells), optionally derives a state column from sample names, and adds the flags rna_pass_qc, dna_pass_qc and s_phase_pass. A cell passes when it passed DNA QC, is not G1, has a finite rep_percent within [min_rep_percent, max_rep_percent] and a non-missing group.

Usage

prepare_metadata(
  meta_data,
  rna_cell_ids,
  group_by_col = "state",
  min_rep_percent = 0.01,
  max_rep_percent = 0.99,
  state_patterns = c(ama = "-ama-", ctr = "mESC-rep")
)

Arguments

meta_data

A data.frame of cell metadata with cell IDs as row names and columns sample, is_G1, rep_percent, pass_qc.

rna_cell_ids

Cell IDs of the RNA count matrix.

group_by_col

Metadata column defining the analysis groups.

min_rep_percent, max_rep_percent

Range of replication progress kept.

state_patterns

Named character vector of regular expressions used only when group_by_col is absent: a state column is created whose value is the name of the first pattern matching sample (NA when none matches). NULL disables this.

Value

meta_data restricted to (and ordered like) the cells shared with rna_cell_ids, with the three flag columns added.
